messages:
Maria P: Quick post-design-review note — noticed a few docs-sidecar issues we should align on: terminology mismatch (console shows "Reserved capacity" in billing but elsewhere we use "Dedicated capacity"), help panel deep-links go to the portal root instead of the exact section, and the sidecar isn't keyboard-focusable in some flows. pinging @Lizzie (design) and @Samira - docs for UX/copy follow-up.

Ashok: Thanks Maria. Agree this is messy. Where do we want the canonical term to live? Product lexicon or docs glossary? Also the current link is the full portal URL. We should prefer stable /docs/ paths with fragments.

Samira - docs: We have a glossary entry for "Dedicated capacity" in docs. I can add a redirect and a fragment anchor like /docs/deployments#dedicated-capacity so deep links land on the right heading. Also can add UTM params for console traffic.

Lizzie (design): UX note — the sidecar currently looks like an overlay with no breadcrumb context. Suggest adding a small breadcrumb line: "Docs › Deployments" and update label from "Reserved capacity" to "Dedicated capacity (reserved pool)" to reduce confusion. Will mock variants.

Ken D: One ask from devex: keep the UI label consistent with SDK/API param names. Our SDK uses "dedicated" in the config. So avoid using "Reserved" alone in any developer-facing label. 

Maria P: For accessibility, I ran a quick check and @a11y-bot flagged a focus trap on the sidecar close flow. Paste minimal snippet from the bot: ```a11y-bot report: sidecar /docs-panel missing aria-modal attribute; tab order lands behind non-modal elements on close; close button not keyboard reachable when opened via keyboard```

a11y-bot: Automated check result: sidecar should use role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby, and trap focus while open. See WCAG guidance: https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/ :warning:

Ashok: I'll spin up a small eng ticket to add the dialog semantics and fix tab order. Question for docs: do we want the sidecar link to open in a new tab or deep-link in the same tab? Embedding docs content in an iframe risks stale copy and complexity.

Samira - docs: Prefer deep-link to the docs page + fragment; open in same tab by default, but console can add a "open in new tab" affordance. We'll also expose canonical meta for link previews (title/description) so the console can show a mini-preview card.

Ken D: Also suggest adding a small "Jump to SDK" link in the sidecar header for devs — one-click to the code sample section. That reduces friction for integrators.

Lizzie (design): 👍 I'll produce three mocks: 1) breadcrumb + corrected label; 2) breadcrumb + label + SDK quick link; 3) same + accessibility focus helpers (visible focus ring, skip link). Posting by EOD.

Maria P: Action items recap: Samira to add redirects and fragments + UTM metadata; Ashok to file eng ticket for aria/dialog + focus trap; Lizzie to upload mocks with copy variants; Ken to add SDK anchor in docs and share link. We'll review in tomorrow's design review. Thanks everyone :rocket:
